Amit Shah calls for presenting Indian history from a native perspective

Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated that decolonisation involves presenting the full and authentic history from an Indian perspective. He also urged for setting aside political differences to promote Indian languages. Shah's remarks suggest a move towards re-evaluating historical narratives and fostering linguistic unity within the country.
